channel.description: Guides on owning software and private AI

item.title: What decides the cost of custom software
item.description: Custom software cost depends on scope, integrations, data and risk. See what moves the price, how to set a budget and how to compare quotes fairly.

item.title: Build or buy software, a practical way to decide
item.description: Custom software or off the shelf? Use five questions to decide when to buy, when to build and when to adapt a proven foundation.

item.title: On-premises, private cloud or air-gapped
item.description: Compare on-premises, private cloud and air-gapped systems by control, cost, updates and staff, and learn how to choose the right one for each workload.

item.title: Self-hosted or subscription software
item.description: Self-hosted vs SaaS without the slogans. Compare real costs, security duties and effort, and see when owning your software is worth it.

item.title: How to avoid vendor lock-in
item.description: Vendor lock-in is the cost of leaving. Learn the four kinds, the contract questions to ask and a simple exit test to run before you sign.

item.title: Who owns the source code you paid for
item.description: Paying for software does not always mean you own the code. What to settle in writing before the project starts, and what a real handover contains.

item.title: How much GPU memory a private AI model needs
item.description: Estimate the VRAM for running an AI model locally. A simple formula, a worked example, and the mistakes that cause out of memory failures.

item.title: When to move from Excel to a CRM
item.description: Seven signs your customer spreadsheet has reached its limit, how to clean the data and a four week plan for moving from Excel to a CRM.

item.title: AI agent security for business, what to check first
item.description: AI agents can act, so their mistakes have consequences. A checklist for access, approval, isolation and records before you let one near your systems.

item.title: Software requirements document, a one page template
item.description: A short software requirements document template for business owners. Nine questions that help suppliers quote accurately and build the right thing.

item.title: How to choose a software company in Pakistan
item.description: How to check a software development company in Pakistan before you pay. Registration, real work, ownership, support and a low risk first project.

item.title: AI agent sandbox, why each task needs its own computer
item.description: What an AI agent sandbox is, what it protects you from and what it does not. Lessons from NOVA, where each conversation has its own contained computer.

item.title: Multi-agent AI, how to make a team of agents dependable
item.description: Multi-agent AI systems fail when roles are vague. How we designed NOVA BOTS around clear roles, visible handoffs, separate memory and human control.

item.title: Arabic and Urdu website development, what usually goes wrong
item.description: Building a website in Arabic or Urdu is more than translation. Right to left layout, fonts, numbers, search and testing, from building our own site.
